name: Tender Impulse
notes: Useful secondary discovery layer for international museum, exhibition, immersive, interactive, multimedia, science-centre and heritage procurements. Radar must not treat Tender Impulse itself as procurement authority: use its source/notice number to locate and verify the original official procurement notice before classifying a record as Live Tender. Search results have surfaced relevant notices sourced from Find a Tender, TED Europa, Spain's PLACSP, Korea G2B, Vietnam MUASAMCONG and other national systems. Apply strict YIPP relevance filtering to reject generic museum services, collection moves, facilities, IT/hardware and unrelated AV supply.
